title: AI Hair Color Changer — 59 Shades & Free Trial
excerpt: Try 59 hair colors or a custom HEX shade on your photo. Compare before-and-after results and download your favorite look. Free trial available.
content_html:
Our hair color change AI lets you preview 59 shades or a custom HEX color on your photo. Compare before and after, then download your favorite look.

59 shades + custom HEX · Before-and-after comparison · Free signup credits

One photo, every shade

Explore Hair Colors on One Photo

Compare AI-generated shade references on the same portrait, from natural tones to bold color. Select a swatch, then try your favorite on your own photo.

Hair Color Changes, Before and After

Explore AI-generated color examples on short cuts, curls and gray hair. Drag each slider to compare the images; these references are not a measured test of your result.

Your New Hair Color in Three Steps

Three steps, no app to download and no dye involved.

1

Upload your photo

Choose a clear, well-lit selfie with your hair visible — or start with one of our sample portraits.

2

Choose a shade and generate

Pick a natural or bold shade, or enter a custom HEX color. Generate a preview on your photo.

3

Compare and download

Drag the slider to compare before and after, try more colors on the same photo, and save your favorite.

Try the hair color changer

01 / Find your shade

Explore Colors for Your Skin Tone

Use your undertone as a starting point, then try a shade on your own photo. These are ideas to explore, not fixed rules.

Skin with pink, red or bluish hints. The veins on your wrist look blue or purple, and silver jewelry flatters you most.

Try icy, ashy and jewel tones: platinum, ash blonde, jet black, burgundy and silver.

Get a personal hair color analysis

02 / Choose your photo

Start with a Clear, Well-Lit Photo

A clear view of your hair gives the preview a better starting point. A simple everyday portrait works well.

  • Face the light. Choose soft, even light that shows your current color.
  • Keep your hair in frame. Include the roots and ends; avoid hats or heavy obstructions.
  • Keep the photo natural. Skip strong filters and blur so the hair texture stays visible.
Try it with your photo

Illustrative examples of lighting and framing.

03 / Plan your next visit

Bring Your Preview to the Salon

Turn a color you like into a clear starting point for a conversation. Your preview helps explain the look you have in mind.

  • Download your favorite result to keep as a reference.
  • Talk through the shade, depth and placement with your colorist.

A preview is a visual reference. Salon results depend on your starting color, hair condition and coloring process.

Create your color reference

AI hair color changer FAQ

Answers to the questions people ask before changing their hair color online.

Upload a clear photo, choose a shade or enter a HEX color, and press Change hair color. When the preview is ready, drag the slider to compare it with your original photo.

New accounts receive 15 signup credits. Each generated image costs 10 credits, including your first preview, so the signup grant covers one image with 5 credits left. Free-tier generation has a wait and a site-wide daily limit; it is not a daily credit refill. Open Pricing for more credits.

The AI is instructed to change hair color while preserving your haircut, face and background. This is an editing goal, not a guarantee that every other pixel stays unchanged. Compare your skin tone, eyes, brows, hairline and background with the original before saving.

You can preview light shades such as platinum on dark hair and compare the effect. The image is a visual reference; your colorist can advise what is achievable from your current hair color.

Use undertone as one starting point: compare an ash or mushroom shade with a golden or copper shade on the same photo. Your preferred contrast and personal taste matter too. The Hair Color Quiz offers six ideas from your answers; the try-on tool lets you compare your own choices.

Yes. Open the Custom tab in the color picker and pick any color or type a HEX code — for example to match a box dye or a salon swatch.

You can explore color on short and long hair, straight hair, waves, curls and gray hair. Results depend on visible hair detail and lighting. A preview cannot establish how well dye will cover gray strands or reproduce your exact curl pattern; check the image before using it as a reference.

A sharp, well-lit, front-facing photo where your hair is clearly visible and not covered by a hat or hood. Natural daylight gives the truest result. JPG, PNG and WebP up to 10 MB are supported.

Photos used for generation are uploaded for AI processing. Source photos and results are stored to support your history; file links can be opened by anyone who has the link. Removing a history entry hides the record, not the stored files. For permanent deletion, use the contact details in our Privacy Policy.

Yes. The hair color changer runs in any modern mobile or desktop browser — there is no app to download.

Still have a question? Email us at support@haircolorchangeai.com.
